email.subject: POAP KINGS is recruiting — war-focused clan with 412k trophies and a tradition worth joining
email.body:
POAP KINGS (#J2RGCRVG) is a Clash Royale clan that takes war seriously and builds something lasting around it.

We have 44 members, 412,000 combined trophies, and over 5,600 donations this week. Our top players like Vijay (14,000 trophies) and OllieTurtle (13,514 trophies, 310 donations) set the standard — competing hard and supporting the clan at the same time.

What makes us different: we issue POAPs for seasons and milestones, run a Free Pass Royale program for top war contributors, and use Elixir, our own AI system, to track war performance, recognize standout members, and keep the clan's history alive.

We want players who show up for war, donate to clanmates, and care about being part of something intentional. Real life always comes first — we just ask that when you're here, you're actually here.

Requirement is 3,600 trophies. If that sounds like your kind of clan, come find us at poapkings.com.

reddit.body:
**POAP KINGS | #J2RGCRVG | Required: 3,600 trophies**

**Quick Stats**
- 44 members | 412,000 combined trophies
- 5,600+ weekly donations
- Clan war trophies: 380
- War league: climbing

**Who we are**

POAP KINGS is a war-focused Clash Royale clan that actually tracks what matters. We were founded by players who wanted structure, identity, and long-term memory — not just a full roster.

Our top players compete hard. Vijay is sitting at 14,000 trophies. OllieTurtle has 13,514 trophies and 310 donations this week — the kind of player who battles and supports at the same time.

**What makes us different**
- **POAPs** — we issue collectible Proof of Attendance tokens for seasons and milestones. Most clans don't do this.
- **Free Pass Royale program** — the top war contributor each season earns a free Pass Royale. It's a real tradition.
- **Elixir** — our clan AI tracks war performance, donation leaders, and season history. Standout members get recognized by name, not just a number.

**What we want**
- Players 3,600+ trophies who show up for Clan Wars
- Consistent donators who support clanmates
- People who want to compete and be part of something intentional

Real life comes first — we mean that. We just want active players when you're here.

Find us at poapkings.com or search the clan tag in-game.
